A grocery store fire in a rural neighborhood in the Philippines had people fearing the worst, until an elephant appeared and began helping firefighters put out the flames.

Witnesses were stunned to see the animal spraying water into the fire, and many said it had become known in the area for stepping in during emergencies whenever extra help was needed.

What started as a terrifying scene quickly turned into the story of an unexpected local hero.
